pre_update_notes: A minor release on top of 2.0.8: a complete Cleanup tool (System → Cleanup) for logs, history, backups and leftover files with a preview before every delete and a verified result, plus fixes to backups (file backups no longer archive earlier backups; retention always keeps the newest and any rollback point) and to log and import cleanup. It applies 3 small additive database migrations (4 new tables for the cleanup history and a one-time date stamp on old inventory log rows) — nothing in your products, orders, invoices, payments or customers is changed or removed. Update from a single browser tab and leave the update page open until it finishes.
post_update_notes: After the update: (1) open System → Cleanup and press 'Refresh numbers' once to measure what can be cleaned — nothing is deleted until you start it. (2) Automatic cleaning is OFF by default; turn it on in System → Cleanup → Settings if you want it (the first automatic run of each item is only a preview, and it needs the scheduler cron to be running). (3) If you had changed 'Log retention (days)' before, that number was copied to each log's own 'Keep (days)'. No new permissions were added.
